span.p:
User
[External Actor]
Operator executing SATRAP
commands via terminal

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CLI Parser
[Component: satrap_cli.py]
Argument parser and command router.
Handles command-line arguments,
builds subcommand menus,
and dispatches to execution functions.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Command Handlers
[Component: commands.py]
Implementation of execution logic for each command:
setup, etl, tl, rules, stats,
techniques, mitigations, etc.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ETL Orchestrator
[Component: ETLOrchestrator]
Coordinates extraction, transformation,
and loading of STIX 2.1 data.
Supports MISP and file sources.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
TypeDB Manager
[Component: typedbmanager]
Creates and manages TypeDB databases.
Initializes schema and inference rules.
Manages database lifecycle.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CTI Analysis Service
[Component: CTIanalysisToolbox]
High-level CTI reasoning engine.
Executes analysis queries and
returns formatted results.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
TypeDB Server
[External System]
Knowledge base storing
CTI and inference rules

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Data Sources
[External System]
MISP instances, MITRE ATT&CK, STIX(2.1)-compliant feeds
